title: Rappler Recap: 4 things we learned from BIR witness about Sara Duterte wealth
summary: How did the prosecution use the Bureau of the Internal Revenue to bolster its unexplained wealth case against the Vice President?

blocks.text: How did the prosecution use the Bureau of the Internal Revenue to bolster its unexplained wealth case against the Vice President?
MANILA, Philippines – Sara Duterte earned from the Davao City government even when she was already vice president, and registered a net income that was much lower than her declared net worth.

Rappler’s Dwight de Leon recaps key details revealed by Anne Loraine Garcia-Marquez, a witness from the Bureau of the Internal Revenue, on the 36th day of the Vice President’s trial on Thursday, October 8. – Rappler.com
